# ADR-037 — Production Android releases: EAS-managed signing keystore + `production-internal` APK profile; no Play publication

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

Production Android releases for `com.himal.personalos` use an EAS-managed app-signing keystore and the `production-internal` internal-distribution APK profile; no Google Play publication. The private key remains only in EAS credential storage. Every release must reuse that remote credential and match the recorded production signing-certificate SHA-256 before installation. This supersedes only ADR-033's no-upload-keystore/no-EAS-cloud-build clause; ADR-033's FCM private-key handling remains locked (Checkpoint 6, user-approved 2026-08-18)
